text: The archive reduces to integer-valued pass rates (units of 0.0001) with one exact daily sum per UTC finish date. I’m classifying each launched run as directly known, recovered from shards, retention-screened, storage-lost, or writer-lost, then I’ll use the daily sums plus the suite and retention bounds to optimize each contrast exactly.

Daily totals link missing scores across configurations, so recovering a run outside the contrasted configurations can still help. For each recovery set, I’m maximizing the remaining interval width over all feasible returned totals; this accounts for the blind commitment requirement and for cases where one recovery helps only when paired with another.
